# Storage Commands

Every command the `storage` module offers, from its declarations, in order of the resource each acts on. Each command's help says the same.

## `lnk storage clean`

Delete files here, only if every cloud has a checked copy

```usage
lnk storage clean <paths> [--dry] [--yes]
```

- `--dry`, boolean: Check, and say what would be deleted, without deleting
- `paths`, position 1, list of string, required: Paths in `~/Link/Files` or an owner's folder
- `--yes`, boolean: Say yes to what it would ask

It answers `core.report`.

## `lnk storage connect`

Use buckets that exist already (from another machine, or after disconnect)

```usage
lnk storage connect <kind> --bucket <bucket> [--cloud <cloud>] [--encrypt] [--endpoint <endpoint>] [--key-id <key-id>] [--name <name>] [--owner <owner>] [--owner-bucket <owner-bucket>] [--path <path>] [--profile <profile>] [--project <project>] [--region <region>] [--setting <setting>]
```

- `--bucket`, string, required: The bucket for your files (for a drive cloud, the folder inside it, such as local-link/personal)
- `--cloud`, string: aws, gcp: the cloud account it is (`lnk cloud list`), and is named as [default: the one named as its type, connected first if there's none]
- `--encrypt`, boolean: Encrypt files and their names before they leave this machine. Lose the password and the files can't be read, by anyone
- `--endpoint`, string: s3: the endpoint URL
- `--key-id`, string: aws (connecting its account), s3: use this access ID (the secret is asked for) instead of an existing login
- `kind`, position 1, string, required: aws, gcp, s3 (R2, Wasabi, MinIO), drive (a folder on one, such as an external drive), or an rclone storage type (`lnk storage rclone help backends`)
- `--name`, string: s3, drive, rclone: what to call it [default: its type]; lets you have two of one type
- `--owner`, string: Whose bucket --owner-bucket is, <kind>:<name>, as the module that keeps that kind names it [default: the only owner with a folder here]
- `--owner-bucket`, string: The bucket for an owner's folder; asks for its encryption password. Without it, one is made, encrypted, on the first push of its files
- `--path`, path: drive: the folder to use, e.g. `/Volumes/MyDrive`
- `--profile`, string: aws: connecting its account, the `~/.aws` profile to use [default: `AWS_PROFILE`, else default]
- `--project`, string: gcp: the project new buckets go in [default: the `lnk cloud` account's]
- `--region`, string: Where new buckets go (aws: [default: the `lnk cloud` account's region]; gcp: a location such as US or europe-west1)
- `--setting`, list of string: An rclone type's setting, KEY=VALUE (repeatable; rclone asks for the rest)

It answers `core.report`.

## `lnk storage create`

Make buckets in a cloud: aws, gcp, s3, drive --path <folder>, or any rclone storage

```usage
lnk storage create <kind> [--cloud <cloud>] [--encrypt] [--endpoint <endpoint>] [--key-id <key-id>] [--name <name>] [--path <path>] [--profile <profile>] [--project <project>] [--region <region>] [--setting <setting>] [--yes]
```

- `--cloud`, string: aws, gcp: the cloud account it is (`lnk cloud list`), and is named as [default: the one named as its type, connected first if there's none]
- `--encrypt`, boolean: Encrypt files and their names before they leave this machine. Lose the password and the files can't be read, by anyone
- `--endpoint`, string: s3: the endpoint URL
- `--key-id`, string: aws (connecting its account), s3: use this access ID (the secret is asked for) instead of an existing login
- `kind`, position 1, string, required: aws, gcp, s3 (R2, Wasabi, MinIO), drive (a folder on one, such as an external drive), or an rclone storage type (`lnk storage rclone help backends`)
- `--name`, string: s3, drive, rclone: what to call it [default: its type]; lets you have two of one type
- `--path`, path: drive: the folder to use, e.g. `/Volumes/MyDrive`
- `--profile`, string: aws: connecting its account, the `~/.aws` profile to use [default: `AWS_PROFILE`, else default]
- `--project`, string: gcp: the project new buckets go in [default: the `lnk cloud` account's]
- `--region`, string: Where new buckets go (aws: [default: the `lnk cloud` account's region]; gcp: a location such as US or europe-west1)
- `--setting`, list of string: An rclone type's setting, KEY=VALUE (repeatable; rclone asks for the rest)
- `--yes`, boolean: Say yes to what it would ask

It answers `core.report`.

## `lnk storage delete`

Delete a cloud's buckets and everything in them, and forget it

```usage
lnk storage delete <name> [--everywhere] [--yes]
```

- `--everywhere`, boolean: Delete it even where it holds the only copy of some files
- `name`, position 1, string, required: The cloud's name (`lnk storage list`)
- `--yes`, boolean: Say yes to what it would ask

It answers `core.report`.

## `lnk storage disconnect`

Forget a cloud and its credentials (deletes nothing in it)

```usage
lnk storage disconnect <name> [--yes]
```

It takes `name`, position 1, string, required: The cloud's name (`lnk storage list`). It takes `--yes`, boolean: Say yes to what it would ask. It answers `core.report`.

## `lnk storage list`

List your clouds, or with --tree what's where: here, offloaded, and in which clouds

```usage
lnk storage list [path] [--dirs-only] [--json] [--level <level>] [--refresh] [--tree]
```

- `--dirs-only`, `-d`, boolean: With --tree, folders only, like `tree -d`
- `--json`, boolean: Print the answer as JSON for other programs
- `--level`, `-L`, integer: With --tree, descend only this many levels, like `tree -L`
- `path`, position 1, string: With --tree, a path in `~/Link/Files` or an owner's folder [default: every folder]
- `--refresh`, boolean: With --tree, list the clouds again first (finds files pushed from another machine)
- `--tree`, boolean: What's where instead: every file of each folder, here, offloaded, and in which clouds

It answers list of `storage.storage`.

## `lnk storage pull`

Get files back from the cheapest cloud that has them, and check each

```usage
lnk storage pull <paths> [--cloud <cloud>] [-- <flags>...] [--remote <remote>] [--replace] [--yes]
```

- `--cloud`, string: Only from this cloud account (`lnk cloud list`)
- `flags`, after `--`, list of string: After --: flags for rclone's copy, e.g. -- --bwlimit 10M
- `paths`, position 1, list of string, required: Paths to get back; globs work: 'photos/**/*.jpg'
- `--remote`, string: Only from this remote: s3, a folder or rclone's (`lnk storage list`)
- `--replace`, boolean: Replace files here that differ from the cloud's copy
- `--yes`, boolean: Say yes to what it would ask

It answers `core.report`.

## `lnk storage push`

Send files to every cloud, and check each copy

```usage
lnk storage push <paths> [--archive] [--cloud <cloud>] [-- <flags>...] [--recheck] [--remote <remote>] [--replace] [--yes]
```

- `--archive`, boolean: Store them in the archive tier (aws, gcp): about $1 per TB a month, but slow and costly to read back
- `--cloud`, list of string: Only these cloud accounts (`lnk cloud list`)
- `flags`, after `--`, list of string: After --: flags for rclone's copy, e.g. -- --bwlimit 10M --transfers 8
- `paths`, position 1, list of string, required: Paths in `~/Link/Files` or an owner's folder (from the current folder when you're in one of them)
- `--recheck`, boolean: Send and check every file, even those unchanged (same size and modification time) since their copy was checked
- `--remote`, list of string: Only these remotes: s3, a folder or rclone's (`lnk storage list`)
- `--replace`, boolean: Replace cloud copies that differ from the files here; without it they're kept and reported
- `--yes`, boolean: Say yes to what it would ask

It answers `core.report`.

## `lnk storage rclone`

Run rclone itself on your clouds: mount, sync, serve, ...

```usage
lnk storage rclone [-- <args>...]
```

It takes `args`, after `--`, list of string: rclone's arguments, e.g. lsd aws: or mount aws: `~/mnt`. It answers `storage.ran`.

## `lnk storage remove`

Remove files from clouds

```usage
lnk storage remove <paths> [--cloud <cloud>] [--everywhere] [--remote <remote>] [--yes]
```

- `--cloud`, list of string: Only from these cloud accounts (`lnk cloud list`) [default: every cloud]
- `--everywhere`, boolean: Remove them even where that's the last copy anywhere
- `paths`, position 1, list of string, required: Paths in `~/Link/Files` or an owner's folder
- `--remote`, list of string: Only from these remotes: s3, a folder or rclone's (`lnk storage list`)
- `--yes`, boolean: Say yes to what it would ask

It answers `core.report`.

## `lnk storage show`

Show how one cloud is set up and what it holds, never a credential

```usage
lnk storage show <name> [--json]
```

It takes `--json`, boolean: Print the answer as JSON for other programs. It takes `name`, position 1, string, required: The cloud's name (`lnk storage list`). It answers `core.report`.
